title: Care for the Universe
text: [Music] the future it would seem from the perspective of this realization that the future of this dramatic creative experiment that god seems to have entered into the future of this evolutionary experiment is very much dependent upon us it's dependent upon the choices we make in the actions we take the universe doesn't exist for us it's not our playground that we we exist for the universe in other words if we if we awaken deeply enough if our awakening is profound enough we will begin to see feel and know directly that the energy and intelligence that created the universe needs us to to do its bidding to to to be its arms and its legs its hands on its feet its eyes and ears and its mind and heart whatever happens it's important that we have the spiritual spiritually inspired courage to continue to care desperately and urgently about what's most important and to live and express virtue with everything we've got no matter what anyone else is doing and no matter how bad things get that's what really counts you
